case_title: Sunil Kumar and Anr. v. State of U.P.
statutory_provisions: IPC s.304, Part II rlw ss.147 and 149
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.304 Part II rlw ss.147 and 149 IPC and sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for four years
offence_finally_established: Murder under s.304 Part II IPC
neutral_facts: The accused formed an unlawful assembly with the common object to commit the murder of the victim. The victim was working in his shop when the accused approached him, insulted him, and started beating him with sticks, causing him to fall down. The victim became unconscious and was later transferred to a medical college where he died due to head injuries caused by blunt weapons. The prosecution presented three eye-witnesses, including the victim's father, who testified about the presence of the accused and their individual acts of assaulting the victim on his head. The evidence was not shaken during cross-examination. The accused were charged under s.304 Part II IPC and sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for four years.
